decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9765. Series context: trend strength 0.1199 and seasonal strength 0.6866; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.279); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.319.
